title: Common Thread Reading Room — field notes

source.name: Dorkflow Design Atlas template authors; an imagined community reading room

humanReaction: The imagined reading room feels welcoming because its editorial hierarchy gives a newcomer a clear place to begin without making every option compete.

borrow.reason: A clear title, short introduction, and one featured next step can orient a first-time visitor.
A small set of important destinations is easier to scan than a menu that gives every destination equal weight.

doNotBorrow.aspect: Whole visual identity or imagined assets
doNotBorrow.reason: This fictional example supplies no real brand or usage rights; adapt only a cited quality when it supports the project's intent.
The example is a prompt for a principle, not a layout or copy template.

underlyingPrinciple: A small number of clearly ordered choices can make an unfamiliar place feel easy to enter.
modernTranslation: Prioritize the user's first useful step and keep secondary destinations visible without competing with it.
